scenes.name: Busywork overload
scenes.transcript: Your team is drowning in busywork.
scenes.visualDescription: Task cards drop into a messy stack while an hours-lost counter climbs to 23h; headline slams in.

scenes.name: Meet NovaMind
scenes.visualDescription: Task cards spiral into a glowing orb that bursts into the gradient NovaMind AI wordmark plus early-access badge.

scenes.name: Agent runs workflow
scenes.transcript: Custom AI agents that run your workflows end to end.
scenes.visualDescription: Four workflow nodes; an AI-agent pulse travels down the connector and checks each node off.

scenes.name: Results count-up
scenes.visualDescription: Three stat cards slide in; numbers and bars count up.

scenes.name: Live in days
scenes.visualDescription: 'not months' struck through; progress bar fills as three onboarding steps check off.

scenes.name: Join the waitlist
scenes.visualDescription: Email typed into waitlist card, cursor clicks Join, success message, avatars + 500+ joined.
